profile.headline: Computer Scientist | Active DoD Top Secret Clearance
profile.summary:
Graduated with a Master of Science in Computer Science from the University of Oklahoma in December 2024, focusing on high-performance computing and embedded systems. Academic projects included designing and developing applications, algorithms, and data structures using programming languages such as C++, Java, Python, and JavaScript.  

Most recently served as a Computer Scientist at the 76th Software Engineering Group (SWEG) at Tinker Air Force Base. Gained experience in distributed systems administration and full-stack development, supported by a strong foundation in APIs, data structures, and embedded systems.

positions.title: E-6B Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Midwest City, Oklahoma, United States · On-site
positions.description: Skills: C# · C++ · Java · Windows Server · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.locationName: Midwest City, Oklahoma, United States · On-site
positions.description: Skills: Java · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Agile Methodologies · Git

positions.title: Mentored Research Experience
positions.description:
Collaborate and communicate with professor and peers to organize an extracurricular M.S. 
exit exam project involving field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs)

Consume research and academic materials involving high-performance parallel computing 
and hash tables to understand how FPGAs can hardware accelerate data storage and 
access in database management systems

positions.title: Academic Projects and Technical Experience
positions.description:
Worked both independently and with other students to design, develop and present a variety of computer science projects during education

Familiar with operating Windows OS, Linux OS, and Microsoft Office on both a personal and academic level, from troubleshooting and application development via command console and low-level logic to producing formatted academic papers and presentations

Entry-level experience in the design, development, and construction of applications, algorithms, and data structures using C++, Java, C#, Python, JavaScript

positions.title: IT Services Specialist Mentor
positions.description:
Utilize problem-solving skills and critical thinking to identify, investigate, and resolve technical 
issues faculty, staff, and student experience with the University of Oklahoma’s devices, 
network, and services

Abstract concepts of complex technology and problems thereof to other parties
Train, lead, and provide guidance to newer service specialists; direct flow of workspace and 
ensure a productive, coordinated environment
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Team Leadership · Communication · Critical Thinking · Teamwork · Resourcefulness

positions.title: SAGE STEAM Camp - IT Specialist
positions.description: Aid faculty in preparations ahead of camp (June 10-18, 2023) concerning acquisition and implementation of electronic devices. Provide general troubleshooting, quality control, setup and maintenance for electronic devices used by the camp faculty and students.

positions.title: Delivery Driver
positions.description: Collect, handle, transport and deliver customers' orders with care while navigating safely and efficiently.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · Food Handling · Navigation · Quick Thinking

positions.title: Guest Service Expert
positions.description: Operate registers, prepare/deliver food to customers, restock/maintain equipment, and perform basic housekeeping duties. Provide a satisfactory dining experience for customers and resolve customer service-based issues.

projects.title: MS Exit Exam Project
projects.description: An exploration of FPGAs from a computer science perspective with the purpose of understanding how they might be used to optimize non-dynamic data structures. As a test case, we implement the same hashmap multiple times under different optimization goals and compare how this hashmap is impacted by FPGA architecture.
